recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of five young men in vibrant 1980s streetwear, posed dynamically around an urban street light pole against a backdrop of green foliage and a clear blue sky, featuring bold, multi-colored, tilted typography in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Dynamic interaction between the subjects and the vertical street pole anchor
Contrast between the organic green foliage and the geometric, colorful clothing patterns
Diagonal typographic alignment mirroring the upward energy of the group pose
High-key natural sunlight creating sharp shadows and saturated primary colors
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subjects
Vibrant 80s color palette including yellow, pink, and primary blue
Mixed textures: knit sweaters, acid-wash denim, and graphic tees

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged in a pyramid-like cluster, filling the central and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical street pole and yellow traffic signal housing provide a structural spine.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold typography top-left, follows the diagonal tilt down through the group, and circles back up via the street pole.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily occupied by the blue sky in the upper right and dark foliage on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural greens and blues provide the environmental base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and white in the clothing pop against the dark foliage.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Hot pink and primary red appear in typography and clothing details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with high-contrast lighting typical of midday sun.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold sans-serif and condensed block lettering
letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with minimal negative space inside counters
Sheared or italicized at a steep 15-20 degree upward angle
Stacked layout with varying widths for each line
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical orientation for connecting words between larger blocks
Overlapping letterforms to create a compact, energetic unit
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-wide and ultra-condensed block styles.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary vertical compression and weight for the secondary text.
Matches the geometric, wide structure of the primary display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle group portrait of five teenage boys in 1980s streetwear (sweaters with geometric patterns, acid-wash jeans) posing around a city street light pole. Background is lush green trees and a bright blue sky. High-contrast midday lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of bold, uppercase, sans-serif text in the top-left corner. Tilt the entire text block 15 degrees upward. Use yellow for the top line, white for the middle line, and hot pink for the bottom line. Ensure the middle line is vertically condensed.

verificationChecks: Is the text tilted at a consistent upward angle?
Are the clothing patterns authentically 80s geometric?
Is the lighting high-contrast with sharp shadows?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the hot pink accent
mustRedesign: Specific comic book graphics on shirts
Exact facial features of the original subjects

avoid: Modern digital clarity or flat lighting

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the faces.
Ensure the yellow of the traffic light matches the yellow in the text.
Verify the perspective is low-angle looking up.
Confirm the presence of acid-wash denim texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Low-Angle Urban Group Portrait] with [1980s Streetwear Aesthetic] and [Multi-Color Tilted Block Typography] to recreate the energetic pop-culture vibe of the late 80s.
